name: opentales-tools
description: Operating manual for OpenTales project tools: choosing tools, bounded reads, safe versioned prose edits, batching, approvals, and delegation.
procedure: Orient with overview and list tools before reading bodies.
Read bounded ranges and copy headVersionId/revision tokens.
Edit with exact contentEdit replacements and the token; batch multi-target changes with applyStoryPatch.
On a stale-token error, re-read and rebase once.
Report applied changes, pending approvals, and failures truthfully.
